source.title: 3 Late-Round Running Backs to Draft
source.author: Josh Shepardson
source.summary: Three half-PPR running backs available after pick 120 who offer usable roles or contingent upside.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Mitchell's explosiveness and fit in Mike McDaniel's offense can support standalone value plus injury-contingent upside.
takeaways.rationale: Mitchell's explosiveness and fit in Mike McDaniel's offense can support standalone value plus injury-contingent upside.
risks: He is not expected to overtake Omarion Hampton.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Allen is a final-round bet to win Washington's early-down and goal-line work.
takeaways.rationale: Allen is a final-round bet to win Washington's early-down and goal-line work.
risks: Jonah Coleman is favored to finish higher and Allen offers little receiving production.
